Bullish bias dominates in AI, oil, equities, gold, bitcoin and oil inventories, reflecting supportive coverage on earnings, geopolitical risk and supply factors. Rates and inflation retain mixed/neutral readings with notable conflict, and the U.S. dollar shows a bearish tilt amid currency‑movement focus.
